category_title: Preschoolers with aggressive behaviors and social-emotional regulation challenges
minimal_context: The tutor is asking the class to clean up their toys and transition to the rug for the next activity.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time to clean up the toys and transition to the circle rug for our next activity.

STUDENT: No! I am not cleaning up!

TUTOR: We have to transition now. Please put the toys away.

STUDENT: I don't want to! You can't make me go to the rug!

TUTOR: Joshua, please join the rest of the group.

STUDENT: I'm not going! And if anyone comes over here I'm going to beat them up!

options.A: Apply increasingly serious disciplinary measures if the transition issues continue over time, utilizing consequences such as classroom suspension, detention, and eventually school suspension.
options.B: Conduct 30-minute one-on-one sessions with the student multiple times per week to implement a behavior plan, ensuring the intervention is consistently followed up by parents at home and in the classroom.
options.C: Display evidence of the student's goals, work samples, and achievements around the classroom, as well as numerous photographs of the students and their peers.
options.D: Address the student's feelings mutually rather than repressing them, allowing for the exploration of disappointments and constraints during transitions and other daily classroom activities.
